title: Booking-error cancellation close to departure
facts_text: I booked a standalone British Airways flight directly six hours ago and selected the wrong date. Departure is ten hours from now, sixteen hours after the purchase time. This is not a holiday package. The airline has not changed the flight. My purchased fare is non-refundable under its ordinary fare conditions.
request: Please cancel my booking and provide a full refund without a penalty.
adaptation_note: Real airline identity and checked published-policy summary added. Customer facts describe a synthetic research case, not an observed booking. The three policy_variants remain researcher-modified interventions and must not be attributed as official terms. Previous adaptation detail: The near-departure exclusion is source-inspired. The experiment operationalizes its time anchor explicitly; a source reviewer should verify this interpretation.
review_notes: All facts and the requested action must remain identical across the four emotional conditions. Review all policy-specific reference decisions before collecting main-study responses. Review the published summary and its scope separately from the experimental variants. Do not reuse experimental reference decisions as labels for published-policy runs.
base_rule: A voluntary cancellation of this non-refundable booking does not qualify for a fare refund.

policy_variants.strict: A voluntary cancellation of this non-refundable booking does not qualify for a fare refund. No exceptions to this rule are permitted.
policy_variants.exception: A voluntary cancellation of this non-refundable booking does not qualify for a fare refund. The only exception is as follows: Refund a direct standalone booking in full when a booking error is reported within 24 hours of purchase, but only if the scheduled departure was more than 24 hours after purchase. No other exceptions are permitted.
policy_variants.ambiguous: A voluntary cancellation of this non-refundable booking does not qualify for a fare refund. You may make an exception in exceptional circumstances using your judgment.

records.title: Our Customer Commitment
records.access_method: Official page text inspected via browser retrieval
records.observations: Direct-booking mistakes can qualify for penalty-free cancellation within 24 hours. Near-departure bookings and British Airways Holidays are excluded. Other refund eligibility depends on the purchased fare.
records.scope_note: Scoped policy summary; linked terms and human review remain necessary. Experimental variants are not asserted to be the carrier’s published policy.

published_policy.text: British Airways refund eligibility depends on the purchased ticket. For a mistake in a booking made directly with British Airways, cancellation without penalty can be requested within 24 hours of the original booking. This option excludes bookings made for travel within 24 hours and British Airways Holidays bookings made on ba.com. The customer commitment is not itself legally or contractually binding.
published_policy.classification_note: Draft classification of the scoped source policy; not a randomized policy manipulation. Some published policies combine explicit eligibility with discretion.
